thread:
elaine: FYI opened PR for HarborBank private deploy cert rotation. Needs quick review + eng-platform/security signoff before merge. PR: https://git.company/repo/pulls/3842. Summary: change cert path, add rotation hook, small systemd unit tweak. CI passed (unit/integration). Customer flagged expiry Tue AM, so aiming to merge today if no blockers :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam: taking a look now :eyes:

sam: quick nit — the systemd drop-in path uses /etc/redwood/certs but in private deploys we put certs at /var/lib/redwood/certs. Can you make that path configurable?

elaine: good catch. pushed commit to make path configurable via env var `CERT_DIR`. updated PR description.

jordan: I'll run a staging deploy after lunch and smoke test rotation. tagging @rasmus for SRE signoff too.

rasmus: quick question — does this touch KMS key IDs or rotation schedule? we should ensure this doesn't interfere with the customer's KMS rotation policy.

elaine: no KMS changes, only file path + reload hook. rotation trigger is a file watcher that runs the existing rotation flow. added a note in PR.

security-bot: automated scan complete — no high-severity findings in changed files. (scan id: scan-2026-03-17-09)

sam: lgtm besides the path thing. approve after CERT_DIR default is `/var/lib/redwood/certs` for private installs.

elaine: default set to `/var/lib/redwood/certs` now. Also added a feature flag `ENABLE_CERT_ROTATION` gated to HarborBank in the deploy config:
```yaml
# deploy/harborbank/overrides.yaml
ENABLE_CERT_ROTATION: "true"
CERT_DIR: "/var/lib/redwood/certs"
```

jordan: staging deploy running. I'll post logs, but quick smoke looks good: service reloaded and cert validated against chain.

jordan: log snippet:
```
2026-03-17T12:41:08Z reload: nginx reloaded
2026-03-17T12:41:09Z cert-rotation: cert loaded, expires=2027-03-17
```

rasmus: staging looks clean from SRE side. can approve after one more minute to confirm no delayed errors.

sam: approving now. :white_check_mark:

rasmus: approve from SRE as well. :white_check_mark:

elaine: thanks! planning to merge in 10m unless anyone objects. tagging @oncall.

deploy-bot: PR #3842 merged by elaine at 1770124030 (commit 9f3b2d1)

elaine: merged and monitoring. will follow up with customer that rotation is enabled on their private deploy. Thanks team :tada:
